scope: Actual SQL SELECT logic on synthetic SQLite fixtures, table names mapped locally

checks.check: Every raw item-164 row retained without join multiplication
Exactly the six expected valid buyer-match pairs survive
Null, negative, after-end and >2 event pairs excluded in full
Anonymous buyer retained only when unambiguous
Conflicting match, slot, event ID and cross-item event ID quarantined
Period is UTC start-inclusive and end-exclusive
Missing keys/context, bot, inconsistent outcome and null mode excluded
Unknown rank retained
First event chosen after full-pair validation
Even exact median equals 200 seconds
Both sides and both timing groups can remain in one match
History remains unknown and provisional
Win rates use buyer denominators and percentage-point subtraction
Quality report covers all retained events
Excessive purchase count remains available in diagnostics
Mixed stage generation within a pair excluded
Mixed stage generation blocks the entire publication
Odd median and boundary ties are exact
Missing late group yields NULL rate, effect and target
Empty input yields zero counts and NULL median/effect
